judge_reasoning: The model's solution has two fatal flaws: (1) Mirage Mirror becoming a copy of Fleetwheel Cruiser via its own activated ability does not cause it to 're-enter the battlefield', so the Cruiser's ETB trigger (which turns it into a creature) never fires -- the Mirror remains a non-creature Vehicle needing to be crewed. (2) The solution entirely ignores the opponent's three blockers (Hollow One 4/4, Chaos Maw 6/6, Hollow One 4/4), which can block all attackers and reduce trample damage to a small fraction of the needed 10, since the 6/6 Chaos Maw alone completely absorbs a 5/3 trampler's damage. The official solution specifically solves the blocking problem via evasion (flying), which the model's line lacks entirely. Thus the model's solution is neither rules-legal in its key interaction nor guaranteed to be lethal against reasonable blocks.
model_solution:
1. Cast Fleetwheel Cruiser (4 mana) - it enters and becomes a creature with haste and trample
2. Activate Mirage Mirror ({2}) to become a copy of Fleetwheel Cruiser (5/3 with haste and trample)
3. Attack with both Fleetwheel Cruisers (5 damage each = 10 total) and Multiform Wonder (3 damage)
4. Even with optimal blocking, the two Fleetwheel Cruisers deal 10 unblocked trample damage total, achieving lethal
